Implementation verdict: APPROVE. The delta is two substantive source edits. (1) install_item4_source_preparation.py line 14 drops trusted() from the read of review/packet-manifest.json. This is sound: verify_result(review) (autonomy_review.py:637) already reads that same packet-manifest.json via regular() (line 640), which rejects symlinks and multi-link files, so symlink/alias protection is preserved; trusted() additionally demanded root ownership of every path component, which wrongly refuses legitimately service-owned (UID 1003) reviewer originals (corroborated by INSTALL_V2.stderr HOST_PROOF_NOT_ROOT_OWNED at line 14, pre-mutation). The manifest is only accepted if it equals m, the independently authenticated packet manifest from verify_packet(packet); the installed source bytes are still read via trusted(packet/'source'/name) and digest-checked against m['source_files'] (INSTALL_SOURCE), and the executing installer/helper bytes are re-checked (INSTALL_EXECUTED_SOURCE). No forgery, escape, or TOCTOU advantage is gained by a UID-1003 writer: a swapped manifest either equals m (truthful) or refuses. Root protection of installed copies (os.chown 0 / trusted() in verify()) is retained; exact packet equality is retained.

(2) CHANGE->REVIEW_CHANGE in both install() (INSTALL_APPROVAL) and verify() (GENUINE_APPROVAL) correctly binds installation to a distinct repair review identity, item4-source-install-repair-20261009, which matches the review packet change_id. Because the repaired source (f62f923) differs from the R34-approved parent (a8d034b), the INSTALL_SOURCE/INSTALL_EXECUTED_SOURCE checks guarantee the repaired bytes cannot install without a fresh independent APPROVE carrying the repair change_id and matching source_sha/runtime_sha256 — i.e. this review is that required gate; no prior approval is reused to bypass it.

The test file confirms the positive path reaches native verification and that verdict/source/packet tampering still refuse with INSTALL_APPROVAL/INSTALL_PACKET. The diff touches no budget/caps/metric/privacy/scientific-admission code; SMOKE_CAP/TOTAL_CAP, reservation envelope, frozen 893-file/99-patient membership, and cleanup/retention are untouched.
